notes.title: Update v1.2.5 - Options Menu
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744249/d9ddf6a944768db0913fa5040e8a97c86c7483c3.png
Update v1.2.5 adds an Options Menu with a few options. Press "Esc" at the Fireplace screen to access it:

Volume - run Pixel Fireplace in the background while doing other things such as listening to music, streaming, or watching videos without hearing the fireplace sounds.

Fullscreen / Windowed - switch between Fullscreen and Windowed modes to drag Pixel Fireplace to a second monior. Switching can also be done by double-clicking. NOTE: DPI scaling needs to be the same on both monitors (eg. 125%) or Fullscreen won't work on the second monitor.

These features were requests by the community. Thanks again for your feedback!

🔥

- Ted

notes.title: Patch v1.2.41 - Bug Fixes, Minor Changes
notes.content:
Hello :) Patch v1.2.41 brings a few bug fixes and minor changes.

NOTE: 🔥 below indicates a change inspired by community suggestions and feedback!

BUG FIXES & CHANGELOG

- The Splash Screen takes less time now on start up.
- You can now press any key to skip the Splash Screen instead of just Enter, Space, and left-mouse click.
- Fixed the size of some GUI text on the Title Screen because they were too large at some resolutions.
- Fixed a bug where more than three logs could be thrown when typed quickly before three had landed.
🔥 Fixed a bug where typing WATER before any logs where thrown would cause a crash.
- Fixed a bug where QUIT didn't turn gold when typed.

HINTS
Thanks for checking out my boring patch notes! Here are a few command hints:

[spoiler]FOREVER[/spoiler]
This will keep the logs from burning down. Type it again to turn it off.

[spoiler]FIREWORKS / FIRECRACKER[/spoiler]
(/ω＼)

[spoiler]TWILIGHT[/spoiler]
I've been using this one a lot lately. It fits well with January's winter-y mood.

Enjoy 🔥

- Ted

notes.title: Update v1.2.4 - Demo, Two New Colors, Fixes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744249/96590065edfe7578f4250fa1ea5c232a53c55baa.gif

Hello! Update v1.2.4 is out and it brings a demo and two new color commands.

NOTE: 🔥 below indicates a change inspired by community suggestions and feedback!

DEMO
There's now a demo available to try out on the Pixel Fireplace store page. Give it a shot and see if Pixel Fireplace vibes with you!

TWO NEW COLOR COMMANDS: PINK AND CMYK

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744249/518de14a22067013f8d806fdccf204689cbd4a4a.png

- Type PINK after the fire is lit to activate the pink color command.
🔥 Type CMYK after the fire is lit to activate the cmyk color command.

HOTFIXES & CHANGELOG
- Adjusted the burn speed of HOTDOG command because it was burning too quickly.
- Fixed a bug with second-screen fullscreen mode where the window could be moved.
🔥 'Esc to quit' added to the title screen.
- Some font adjustments to address inconsistencies.
- Added some characters to a font for the demo pop up message. They're not used for commands.

KNOWN ISSUES
- If a second screen has different DPI scaling compared to the main screen, second-screen fullscreen mode won't work. I don't know yet if this is fixable or if it's an engine bug. For now, set DPI scaling the same on both screens (eg. 125%) to allow second screen fullscreen mode. The resolutions can be different, by the way (eg. 1920x1080 and 3840x2160).


Thank you to the community for suggestions, feedback, and support! 🔥


- Ted
